BiblicalUsage: The word is treasure, hidden away and hoarded. It appears once, in Daniel's vision of the king of the north, who will seize the treasures of gold and silver and all the precious things of Egypt.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is a warning: treasures men hide away are the very things a conqueror seizes first, and no hoard is safe from God.
